about.title: Engineering with clarity, scale, and care.
paragraphs: I'm a full-stack software engineer who enjoys turning complex, sometimes vague requirements into clear, resilient systems. My work spans product discovery, backend architecture, and mobile delivery — with a habit of staying close to the problem until the solution feels obvious in hindsight.

I care about the boring things that make software trustworthy: clean domain models, sensible error handling, tests that actually catch regressions, and documentation the next engineer will thank you for.

projects.title: Selected work, built end to end.
projects.description: A mix of production apps and personal builds — each one shipped, not just prototyped.

items.title: MaSchool
items.summary: An education platform for Ethiopian students, built around exam simulations and structured study content.
highlights: Cross-platform Flutter app used by students preparing for national exams
Content pipeline for structured exam simulations and study material
Designed for low-bandwidth, multi-device access

items.title: Ma'ed Platform
items.summary: An operations platform for cafe and restaurant workflows, coordinating orders, staff, and admin reporting in real time.
highlights: Order orchestration across kitchen, staff, and admin views
Admin dashboards for daily operations and reporting
Event-driven data flow for real-time status updates

items.title: Mistir Encryption
items.summary: A desktop tool for encrypting and decrypting files locally, built with usability for non-technical users as the priority.
highlights: File-based encryption workflow with a plain-language interface
All processing handled locally — no data leaves the device
Applied practical cryptography without exposing implementation complexity to the user

items.title: Mesob Equb
items.summary: A digital rotation savings and credit association (Equb) platform modernizing traditional group savings workflows.
highlights: Automated payout tracking and member contribution schedules
Intuitive UI designed for transparent community savings management
Secure mobile transaction workflows

items.title: Ashara Task
items.summary: A collaborative task management and team operations platform built for structured workflows.
highlights: Real-time task tracking, state management, and team assignment dashboards
Optimized query performance and data synchronization for fast page loads
Role-based access control for administrative oversight

items.title: Yashenifu
items.summary: A mobile application delivering structured promotional draws, lucky card UI, and user engagement features.
highlights: Custom UI components for draw lists and interactive reward cards
Smooth layout transitions tailored for mobile responsive displays
Integrated backend endpoints for verified user participation

items.title: FiraSec
items.summary: A security diagnostic tool designed for multi-platform device management and system identification.
highlights: Low-level hardware queries using specialized host libraries
Responsive workstation interface built for system diagnostic monitoring
Efficient device info extraction across connected mobile clients

items.title: Odaa Password Manager
items.summary: A privacy-focused password management application for secure offline credential storage and generation.
highlights: Zero-knowledge architecture ensuring client-side master Key derivation
Local encrypted vault storage with AES cryptographic standards
Built-in password strength analyzer and secure random generator
